mapper.select: select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiTypeCode, d.BUSI_TYPE as busiType, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr, d.PS as psCode, d.PS as ps, d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarketCode, d.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, d.INV_AIM as invAimCode, d.INV_AIM as invAim, DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate, d.CCY as ccyCode, d.CCY as ccy, d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt, d.INT_AMT as intAmt, d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatusCode, d.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d inner join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
